messages.subject: serif text, again
parts:
it gets a bit worse ... my previous 'solution' did set all text
elements to family="serif", but also
destroyed previous distinctions between them (colour, size, angle) which
I wanted to preserve.
My clever new attempt doesn't appear to set the family ... ???


library(ggplot2)
d <- data.frame(x=runif(10),y=runif(10))
g1 <- ggplot(d,aes(x=x,y=y))+geom_point(); g1
theme_orig <- theme_get()
text_elements <- grep("title|text",names(theme_orig),value=TRUE)
theme_orig_text <- theme_orig[text_elements]
theme_new_text0 <- lapply(theme_orig_text,function(x)
theme_text(family="serif"))
theme_new_text1 <- lapply(theme_orig_text,function(x) {
attr(x,"call")$family <- "serif"; x })
do.call(theme_update,theme_new_text1); g1 ## does not set family?
do.call(theme_update,theme_new_text0); g1
## works, but destroys original distinctions (size, angle, etc.)
## among various text elements

any ideas ... ?

Ben Bolker
